_about: AttestedEscrow lock ids for fiat trades. tradeIdHash = keccak256(utf8(tradeId)); lockId = keccak256(abi.encode(funder, tradeIdHash)), AttestedEscrow.lockIdOf. Computed independently with `cast keccak` and `cast abi-encode`, not by either implementation. Read by the aggregator (recoil-core/aggregator/crates/types/tests/fiat_lock_vector.rs, oif_types::fiat_trades::onchain) and by the Merchant Agent (repo recoil-labs/merchant-agent, crates/agent-core/src/chain/lock_id.rs), so both derive the same lock for the same trade. Test values only. nonces: the Permit2 nonce a trade's lock is signed with, lockNonce = keccak256(utf8("recoilpay/fiat-lock-nonce/v1:" + tradeId)) (oif_types onchain::lock_nonce), computed with `cast keccak`. permit: the EIP-712 digest of Permit2 PermitWitnessTransferFrom with witness EscrowLock(bytes32 tradeId, address counterparty), domain {name: Permit2, chainId, verifyingContract}, the digest AttestedEscrow.lockFor verifies; the same vector as attested-escrow/test/fixtures/README.md (pinned there by the Solidity test against viem). The aggregator relay (oif_service::lock_for_digest) checks it, and the Merchant Agent signs merchant-signed purchase locks with it (crates/agent-core/src/purchases/permit.rs).
